name: RIP without split horizon (no count to infinity while triggered updates work)
about: R1 — R2 — host LAN, split horizon off on both routers, short timers. R2's LAN cable is cut. R2 tells R1 at once (a triggered update), so R1's stale route never comes back to R2. Compare count-to-infinity.json, where triggered updates are off and the two routers count to 16.
